note: Custom add another customises the 'Add another item' and 'Remove' button labels on unlimited-cardinality fields. It has no configure route (configure=null), no settings page, no permissions, no Drush and no plugins. Its only persistent state is two third-party settings on a FieldConfig entity: field.field.<entity_type>.<bundle>.<field>.third_party_settings.custom_add_another.custom_add_another (add-another label) and .custom_remove (remove label). The options only appear on the field-instance edit form when cardinality is Unlimited (-1) and the storage is unlocked. All medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config: introspection reads back which unlimited field has a custom label; execution sets the custom label on a live FieldConfig, verified via getThirdPartySetting.

evals.prompt: Using the Drupal custom_add_another module, where do I change the text of the 'Add another item' button for a multi-value field, and where is that text stored?
evals.expected_output: There is no settings page. On the field instance edit form (Manage fields > Edit) you fill in 'Custom add another item button'. It is saved as a third-party setting on the FieldConfig: field.field.<entity_type>.<bundle>.<field>.third_party_settings.custom_add_another.custom_add_another.

evals.prompt: In the custom_add_another module, under what condition does the option to customise the button appear on a field? Does it work on a field limited to one value?
evals.expected_output: The custom label fields only appear when the field's Number of values (cardinality) is Unlimited (-1) and the field storage is not locked. On a single- or fixed-count field there is no 'Add another' button, so the options do not show.

evals.prompt: Which button labels can the custom_add_another module change on a multi-value field?
evals.expected_output: It can change both the 'Add another item' button label (custom_add_another key) and the 'Remove' button label (custom_remove key). It also relabels the upload/remove buttons on multiple managed_file (file/image) widgets.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the 'CAA Known' (caa_known) content type has an unlimited multi-value field whose 'Add another item' button has been given custom text via custom_add_another. Inspect the live field configuration and give the exact custom button text.
evals.expected_output: The custom text is 'Add another highlight': field.field.node.caa_known.field_caa_lbl third_party_settings.custom_add_another.custom_add_another = 'Add another highlight'.

evals.prompt: The 'CAA OnOff' (caa_onoff) content type has two unlimited fields, field_caa_on and field_caa_off. Exactly one has a custom 'Add another' button label set via custom_add_another. Inspect the live field configuration and state which field has the custom label.
evals.expected_output: field_caa_on has the custom label: field.field.node.caa_onoff.field_caa_on carries third_party_settings.custom_add_another.custom_add_another, whereas field_caa_off has none.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the 'CAA Add' (caa_add) content type has an unlimited field field_caa_add. Using the custom_add_another module, set that field's 'Add another item' button text to exactly: Add another highlight. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set third_party_settings.custom_add_another.custom_add_another to 'Add another highlight' on field.field.node.caa_add.field_caa_add (via the field edit form's 'Custom add another item button', or setThirdPartySetting on the FieldConfig and save).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the 'CAA Rm' (caa_rm) content type has an unlimited field field_caa_rm. Using the custom_add_another module, set that field's 'Remove' button text to exactly: Remove this highlight. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set third_party_settings.custom_add_another.custom_remove to 'Remove this highlight' on field.field.node.caa_rm.field_caa_rm (via the field edit form's 'Custom remove button', or setThirdPartySetting on the FieldConfig and save).
